The gap spans the whole receipt artifact rather than one field value.
changes: Require the five existing writer-owned envelope fields to be present before durable persistence while preserving their current nullable/value semantics.
Publish the same complete envelope in the v0.1 required set without changing authority policy, field meanings, signing, or trust architecture.
